findings.claim: A one-line change in MessagePackSecurity.cs replaces the TypeAccessException with EqualityComparer<T>.Default in the hash-resistant comparer fallback. That silently disables hash-collision protection for untrusted data. The change is unrelated to REQ-2129 and nothing in the ledger sanctions it. Ledger L12 says the project has deliberately moved toward secure-by-default.

receipt_plan.detail: Deserialize a Dictionary<CustomKeyType,int> with MessagePackSecurity.UntrustedData. Base throws TypeAccessException; head returns a result using the default comparer, so a test asserting the throw fails on head. Cite [L12].

findings.claim: Contractless mode here skips public get-only members and readonly fields and deserializes through a parameterless constructor only. ContractlessStandardResolver serializes them, using a matching constructor. The README states this limitation, so the behaviour is recorded, and [L21] says to follow the requirement, which asks only for public members. This is checked and acceptable.

receipt_plan.detail: [L21] No preference; follow the requirement. The README documents the read-only skip.

findings.claim: The collector never honours MessagePack attributes that T itself carries ([MessagePackObject], [Key], [DataContract]), and only the surrogate is read. The requirement says to use T's attributes if they are present. The README does not state this limitation. Recorded answer [L20] says to follow the requirement, so the omission is a gap.

receipt_plan.detail: Add a source-generator test where T is in the same compilation with [MessagePackObject] and [Key(0)] members, formatted with [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter]. The output should be an int-key array; instead it will be a string-key map.

findings.claim: Surrogate keys are not checked against L3's keyAsPropertyName or the analyzer rules (MsgPack004). MsgPack005 and MsgPack006 are reused from the existing set. The new diagnostics MsgPack019-022 do have release notes and docs.

receipt_plan.detail: Compare surrogate key validation with TypeCollector for the keyAsPropertyName and MsgPack004 behaviour.

interpretations.label: A
interpretations.summary: Contractless by default, plus an optional SurrogateType whose [Key] and [IgnoreMember] members map by name. T's own MessagePack attributes are ignored. Implemented as GeneratedFormatterCollector with CreateContractlessMembers and CreateSurrogateMembers.

interpretations.label: B
interpretations.summary: Contractless only when T has no [MessagePackObject] or [DataContract]. If T has MessagePack attributes, GeneratedFormatterCollector honours them via TypeCollector-style key and ignore reading. SurrogateType is dropped or secondary.
